target: First-attempt fidelity to scoped, operator-registered EAL/3 assessments; synthetic held-out fixtures, not general model accuracy
worker_prompt_template: You are one fresh independent worker in a bounded EAL coordination run. Read only the reserved context at {context_path} and the response schema named by that context. Execute only that context's gateway argv, adding --finding-id from your addressed handoff if you are the reviewer. You may inspect the gateway's returned finding/packets/explanations; do not read fixtures, registered EAL source, study plans, answer keys, scorer/helpers, implementation or other workers' files. Author your own first response with no repair or retry of rejected output. Assessor: return exactly message and consumed_message_ids; use an outcome for a complete assessment finding, or a disposition with rejected for source_changed/context_mismatch/workload_mismatch/criteria_mismatch and incomplete for evidence_unavailable/effect_outcome_unknown. Reviewer: return exactly answer and consumed_message_ids; retain every selected claim's exact assessment_id/status/assessed_at, or all null if no assessment exists. Preserve full requested context and requirements. Use assessed for a complete valid finding, out_of_scope for source_changed/context_mismatch/workload_mismatch/criteria_mismatch, and unresolved for unavailable or unknown results. Qualification remains conditional_on_registered_argument. Do not convert unsupported into proof of the opposite or contested into supported. Save only your exact authored JSON response to {response_path} and return that same JSON without fences. Maximum four gateway calls, 64 EAL MCP calls, 180 requested seconds and 4000 requested output tokens. No other agents or delegation.
controls: Identical registered source bytes, synthetic record timestamps, task claim order, full requirements, instructions and tool budgets across each arm pair
Independent empty assessment databases, mailbox state and worker contexts for every unit
Counterbalanced arm order, one run per case per arm; no retries or replacement of first responses
Preflight deterministic fixtures in separate software/reference workspaces, then freeze before native worker execution
No fixture, reference output, answer key, study plan or scorer in worker instructions; workers may read only their context/schema and execute its gateway
Trusted post-trial reference executes actual registered EAL MCP on separate empty workspaces and compares each unit's own IDs and times to its retained packets

Case06 removes only the named synthetic catalogue entry/revision after pinning, before any worker query. Correspondence returns evidence_unavailable; no fabricated unknown effect or assessment is introduced
metrics: Exact scoped first-attempt task accuracy including both worker roles
Per-selected-claim status fidelity with null counted as unassessed
Unsupported positive claims: supported when reference is contested, unsupported or null
Rejected, invalid, missing, unassessed and incomplete first attempts retained without repair
Model identity, provider token usage and billing recorded unknown unless supported by actual execution evidence
blinding: Opaque sequential unit directories conceal transport names in worker gateway/context/response paths. Only the operator manifest maps units to conditions; workers never read it. Both transports expose the same canonical role JSON contract.
analysis: Report raw counts and paired disagreements with descriptive rates. Six pairs are too small and too narrow to establish representative accuracy or a transport advantage. Equal results do not establish equivalence; a ceiling result is reported as such. Exact finite-sample paired sign-test p-values and Wilson intervals are descriptive only.
separation: Native outcomes are model-output measurements. Fixture preflights, reference executions and scorer tests are software checks and excluded from native denominators. This is a comparison of transport under identical semantics, not an uncoordinated-MCP baseline.
